complicacoes.texto: Klarion was born e raised in an underground faux-Puritanical settlement that practiced necromancy e had no contact com the surface world. As such, he is very out of place in normal social situations e misses many social cues.

Klarion has large, dark eyes, pointy ears, black lips e fingernails, e bluish- white skin, in addition, he dresses in Puritan-style garb, all of which makes him look very unusual. Klarion looks even more unusual when he assumes his Horigal form, which is horrible e horrific.
